PRIMITIVE · qeva:1:set@1

Set

A set is a collection treated extensionally: its members determine it.

editorialset-theory · foundations
Trace this conceptSearch connections

PLAIN

The idea

A set is a collection treated extensionally: its members determine it.

EXACT

The compact statement

In an axiomatic set theory, set is primitive and extensionality states ∀A∀B[(∀x(x∈A↔x∈B))→A=B].

Example

{1,2} and {2,1} denote the same set under extensional equality.

Boundary / caveat

Not every foundation takes sets as primitive; this node is a switchboard entry, not an absolute ontology.

Assumptions

  • The declared set-like mathematics context is fixed.

Historical links

  • 1870s · Rigorous real numbers and set theory
